title: Green Lantern Corps #213 217 Lot DC 1987 Star Sapphire Sinestro Englehart Staton
condition_description: Both covers bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Green Lantern Corps #213 (June 1987) and #217 (October 1987), DC Comics - written by Steve Englehart with art by Joe Staton and Bruce Farmer. Original 75 cent cover price each.

You get both issues:
- #213 "Slave of the Star Sapphire!" - back cover: American Defense action figures (Kmart) ad
- #217 "Sinestro Strikes!" - back cover: TSR Forgotten Realms (AD&D) ad

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
